2607.25907.title: Minimizing Targeted Activations: Input-Only Suppression of Evaluation-Awareness Latents in Large Language Models
2607.25907.paper_summary: Activation steering controls model behavior by editing internal activations at inference time. We study its input-side dual: optimizing a fluent prompt so that a chosen internal latent is driven toward zero, with no inference-time model access. Our target is an "evaluation-awareness" latent-linearly readable and steerable in recent work-whose control would threaten the validity of safety evaluations if models behave differently when they detect being tested. Adapting Fluent Dreaming / EPO with a negated feature term (GCG-style token optimization plus a self-cross-entropy fluency regularizer, swept over a fluency weight), we suppress the latent under five target constructions-a CAA direction, a subspace norm, an SAE feature, a single MLP neuron, and a behavioral logit-on Llama-3.2-3B and Llama-3.1-8B. The latent is robustly suppressible ($z\approx-7$), and a causally-validated Llama Scope SAE feature can be fully and selectively turned off. But our controls tell a cautionary story about the CAA direction: a placebo random direction is suppressed just as hard and shifts behavior just as far, and when we hold a real eval passage in context and optimize only a prefix, suppressing the eval-direction fails to reduce-and slightly increases-the model's behavioral eval judgment. Activation-readability, in short, is not behavioral controllability. We further find that a single MLP neuron is eval-correlated but not causal at both scales, and that scanning the real Pile yields a natural-text baseline competitive with the optimizer for the internal direction. A positive control validates our erasure detector, bounding an erasure-vs-rotation question earlier left open.
2607.25907.paper_summary_zh: 啟動引導控制透過在推理時編輯內部激活來模型行為。我們研究其輸入端的對偶：優化流暢的提示，使選定的內部潛在驅動至零，而無需在推理時訪問模型。我們的目標是一個“評估意識”的潛在-在近期工作中線性可讀和可引導-其控制將威脅安全評估的有效性，因為如果模型在檢測到被測試時行為不同。通過使用否定特徵項（GCG風格的標記優化加上自我交叉熵流暢性正則化器，掃描流暢性權重），我們在五個目標構造下抑制潛在-一個CAA方向、一個子空間範數、一個SAE特徵、一個單一的MLP神經元，以及一個行為邏輯值-在Llama-3.2-3B和Llama-3.1-8B上。潛在是穩健可抑制的（$z\approx-7$），並且一個因果驗證的Llama Scope SAE特徵可以完全且選擇性地關閉。但我們的控制告訴了一個關於CAA方向的警示故事：一個安慰劑隨機方向被抑制得同樣厲害，並且行為的轉變同樣遠，當我們在上下文中保持一個真實的評估段落並僅優化前綴時，抑制評估方向未能減少-並稍微增加-模型的行為評估判斷。簡而言之，激活可讀性並不等同於行為可控性。我們進一步發現，單一的MLP神經元在兩個尺度上與評估相關但並不因果，並且掃描真實的Pile產生了與優化器在內部方向上競爭的自然文本基準。一個正控制驗證了我們的抹除檢測器，界定了一個早先未解的抹除與旋轉問題。
